title: Recent Payment Reduction on Deficiency Balance Account Plan Installments
content:
**Rule.** The installment of a new payment plan on an account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts is reduced for recent paying. The plan recent payments are the payments posted on the account dated fewer than 6 whole months before today, less the returned payments dated in the same period; 2 or more plan recent payments reduce the installment by 4.0 percent, exactly one reduces it by 2.0 percent, and any smaller count (none, or fewer once returns are taken off) by nothing. Whole months are counted as the difference in calendar months between the two dates, less one when the later date's day of the month is below the earlier date's.

## Input, judgement, output

| Posted in the last 6 whole months | Returned in the same period | Plan recent payments | Reduction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0 | 3 | 4.0 percent |
| 2 | 0 | 2 | 4.0 percent |
| 2 | 1 | 1 | 2.0 percent |
| 1 | 0 | 1 | 2.0 percent |
| 1 | 1 | 0 | None |
| 0 | 1 | below zero | None |

(Hypothetical counts.)

## Points of judgement

- Every posted payment counts, whether or not it was made toward an arrangement, and whatever its channel.
- A return is taken off by its own date: a return dated inside the period is taken off even when the payment it returns was posted earlier.
- Hypothetically, with today the 12th of a month, a payment dated the 13th six months earlier is 5 whole months back and counts; one dated the 12th six months earlier is 6 whole months back and does not.
